title: SINTESI
subtitle: Multifunctional smart station digital gym
about_html: SINTESI is a compact, state-of-the-art digital gym that merges aerospace technology with modern fitness. Experience versatile workouts in just two square meters, anywhere. Control gravity, train like never before and be amazed by ourpatented Dynamic Vectoring technology, which allows SINTESI to simulate the behaviour of free weights, elastic resistance, rowing machines and numerous other traditional pieces of kit. With the tablet provided, you can set up your routine at the touch of a button, view your performance data in real time and take your workouts to the next level.

blocks.html:
The Digital Gym Evolution

Discover SINTESI by Akuis Tech - the epitome of digital fitness.

Compact design meets aerospace tech for a transformative workout experience


Pure technology

The technological heart of Sintesi is optimized to offer all the tools necessary for effective, measurable and motivating training.

With Sintesi the classic multifunctional gym has evolved into something new, capable of combining maximum freedom of movement with the precision and power of a robot.

ROBOT WORKOUT MACHINE

An innovative device that provides a new way of doing physical activity both in sports and in rehabilitation.

Its technology is based on the use of electric motors to generate a load

that simulates one of the most varied equipments used in gyms.

All working parameters are set by a simple tablet that is always connected to the machine

and shows in real-time relevant and objective data on training,

with the ability to store and compare them to allow the trainer to develop “workouts" constantly at their best.

Think of the whole App

All the possible combinations of functions are easily accessible thanks to our Sintesi App,

which offers pre-set exercises for those who want to think only of training,

leaving the freedom to play with the advanced parameters

to those who want to exploit all the potential of Sintesi.

Your gym in 2m² Sintesi

Control gravity, train like never before and be amazed by our patented Dynamic Vectoring technology,

which allowsSintesi to simulate the behaviour of free weights, elastic resistance, rowing machines

and numerous other traditional pieces of kit. With the tablet provided,

you can set up your routine at the touch of a button, view your performance data

in real time and take your workouts to the next level.

THE DIGITAL LOAD

A NEW KIND OF WORKOUT

Unlike traditional weights (dumbbels or isotonic machines), the electric motors technology allows to obtain a smooth and constant resistance which is not affected by torque and gravity. This greatly enhances the recruitment of muscle groups, during the movement, improving the result in less time.

In addition, the load can be varied in real time and deactivated at any time. In this way laborious handling operations of the fisical weights are eliminated, improving the professional operativness and reducing the risk of accidents.

blocks.title: Mediterranean
blocks.html:
The Mediterranean is a modular four-seat chamber available in 1.5, 2.0 and 2.4 ATA pressure models. It offers spacious design, customizable options, and advanced automation for an effective and enjoyable therapy experience.

  • Engineered with a modular design with each section less than a standard 80 cm wide doorway and assembled on location.
  • External 21”/Internal 16” Tesla style touch screen control tablets with custom protocols & entertainment.
  • Dual BIBS and Free-Flow oxygen delivery systems powered by two x 5.0 Bar 20 LPM (each) oxygen concentrators, with an optional chiller for enhanced comfort.

blocks.title: Product Description
blocks.html:
The Mediterranean is a 4-Person Hyperbaric Chamber designed to provide a luxurious hyperbaric experience. With pressure options of 1.5, 2.0 and 2.4* ATA, it is ideal for group sessions focused on sports recovery, wellness, and clinical therapies. The chamber’s aerospace aluminum or steel* construction ensures durability, while two large panoramic windows promote visibility.

Users breathe high-purity oxygen through a dual BIBS mask or Free-Flow system (mask or cannula), powered by four x 5.0 Bar 20 LPM (each) oxygen concentrators* eliminating the need for oxygen tanks. A chiller* maintains a comfortable interior temperature during sessions. An internal/external Tesla style touch screen control tablet features custom protocols programming, real-time pressure, oxygen levels, speed, temperature, precise adjustments and session tracking. The chamber can be operated without external assistance.

Inside, the Mediterranean offers a choice of lounge chairs or Maybach* recliners. The spacious interior promotes relaxation and social connection, making it suitable for friends, family members, or teams undergoing therapy together. Advanced communication systems ensure clear interaction between users and operators, while integrated entertainment options personal tablets provide a first-class experience.

Mediterranean’s range of custom options, including the choice of exterior color, accent finishes, interior lining, and eco-leather upholstery seats, allows clients to personalize the chamber to their aesthetic preferences or facility design.

* Optional

blocks.title: System Features
blocks.html:
Dual Oxygen Delivery Systems

  • Providing a customized user experience, the ProReset x HPOTech hyperbaric chambers include a unique dual oxygen delivery system with the flexibility to switch to either BIBS mask or Free Flow (mask or cannula) system.

Built-in Breathing System (BIBS)

  • BIBS is an advanced oxygen delivery system providing oxygen on demand only when a user needs to inhale. Oxygen is provided through a mask and sourced from a high-efficiency oxygen concentrator delivering 20 LPM (liters per minute). The BIBS system delivers oxygen regardless of the user’s breathing patterns, making it ideal for individuals with respiratory challenges or limited lung capacity. BIBS helps prevent carbon dioxide (CO₂) buildup by maintaining constant airflow, enhancing safety during hyperbaric oxygen therapy sessions. Its user-friendly design requires minimal user interaction.

Free Flow Oxygen Delivery System

  • The Free Flow system offers a simple and effective method for delivering oxygen in hyperbaric chambers. Utilizing a 20 Lpm oxygen concentrator, it provides a continuous oxygen stream delivered directly to the user’s respiratory system via a mask or nasal cannula offering flexibility and comfort during sessions. The Free Flow system is ideal for those seeking a more flexible experience. Its simplicity, ease of use, and low maintenance make it a practical option.

High Power Oxygen Concentrator

  • The high-powered oxygen concentrator is designed to deliver 20 LPM of ±93% ±3% oxygen content at 5.0 Bar pressure to each user. This ensures that every breath taken within the hyperbaric chamber is enriched with the vital oxygen, maximizing the potential for wellness, recovery and performance.

Air Compressor

  • The Air Compressor inflates the chamber body with filtered room air. The system compresses, maintains the user at the desired pressure, and decompresses the chamber when required. Chamber pressure and session duration are controlled by the user from the interior or from the operator from the exterior according to protocol recommendations.

Chiller System

  • A chiller system for hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) is a component that helps regulate and maintain the temperature inside the chamber. When users are inside the chamber, the increased atmospheric pressure can cause the temperature to rise. The chiller system counteracts this effect by efficiently cooling the chamber and maintaining an optimal temperature for a comfortable hyperbaric experience.

title: VACUMED®
subtitle: Intermittent Vacuum Therapy (IVT)
about_html:
High Care® Medial is the proven Intermittent Vacuum Therapy (IVT)

which is conducted by means of the VACUMED® device.

This unique low pressure treatment was developed in a collaboration of Weyergans

and the institute of the German Society of Aerospace Medicine.

Due to its special technique, the low pressure tube for body and arms is internationally known and reknown.

blocks.html:
INTERMITTENT VACUUM THERAPY

Origin in space medicine

The Intermittent vacuum therapy -IVT- has its technological origin in space medicine.

In the absence of gravity (weightlessness),astronauts in space must

negative pressure application in an LBNPD (Lower Body Negative Pressure Device)

every ten hours to avoid orthostatic complications due to an insufficient baroreflex

This is the only way to ensure sufficient blood flow in the periphery

The further development of the LBNPD is the innovative VACUMED® 

Flow Regeneration System. The procedure was developed by Weyergans High Care AG

together with the Institute of Space Medicine of the German Aerospace Center (DLR)

Intermittent vacuum therapy - IVT -

Alternately applies negative pressure (vacuum)

and positive pressure to the lower extremities.

This physiologically causes rhythmic vascular dilation

and vascular compression, through that naturally provoking and the

>>flow<< in a purely physical way.


The result: Blood circulation, capillarization and increase in venous and lymphatic reflux.

blocks.title: Walker View 3.0 SCX
blocks.html:
Walker View 3.0 SCX was born from TecnoBody research and allows you to fully analyze

the strengths and weaknesses in the athletic gesture or simply in walking.

Not a simple treadmill, but a walking and running analysis laboratory concentrated

in a single innovative product capable of returning a postural analysis report of

Run Analysis and Gait Analysis for rehabilitation and sports medicine.


The immediate and objective feedback allows to improve the posture in movement,

the load of the lower limbs and much more both during walking and running.


The SCX Speed Control feature applied to the Walker View system redefines the world of treadmills.Walker View 3.0 SCX, in fact, works in self-adaptive mode and is capable of recognizingthe user’s gesture and adapting to the rhythm of his step and stride.


The revolution in the re-education of the path in running bears the name of

Walker View 3.0 SCX. Discover all the advantages!

blocks.title: What does self-adaptive treadmill mean?
blocks.html:
The Walker View 3.0 SCX treadmill adapts to the gesture of the user, whether he is a patient engaged in walking or an athlete while he’s running. This means that the user is intuitive to determine the actuation of the system, the speed of the belt and the stop, through:

  • Position detection in front of the 3D camera: In just 5 seconds the system recognizes and marks the patient or runner on the belt.
  • 3D Camera: The 3D volumetric camera is able to detect the position of the joints and any movement of the subject.
  • Sensorized base with load cells: The 8 load cells under the tape detect the subject’s loads, the length and the variation of the step.
  • SENSOR FUSION: The interaction between load cells, 3D camera and software re-elaboration summarizes the information necessary to obtain a complete analysis of the step and stroke.
  • Real time bio-feedback – The Full HD 49" screen is the digital mirror in which the subject displays their image, the analysis of the gesture and the detailed report data processed by the system, everything in real time.

blocks.title: Software - Gait Analysis and Run Analysis
blocks.html:
Gait Analysis and Run Analysis

The Gait Analysis module allows you to perform a complete postural analysis

while walking and in the same way the module dedicated to 

Run Analysis is focused on running, for all the runner’s needs.

During the tests, all data relating to the phases of the step are collected to return a detailed report on:

• support times for each foot

• Step length

• joint rotations of ankle, knee and hip

• vertical displacement of the CoG and many other data.

All the data collected contribute to building a picture of possible balance and posture disturbances during walking or running.

blocks.title: Gait Trainer
blocks.html:
The Gait Trainer module allows the operator to reconstruct a mapping of the patient’s or athlete’s pace through a bio-feedback correction of the gait.

The correction takes place thanks to the presence of regulatory bands in the graphics reproduced on the screen for the user who carries out the test, together with the acoustic signals that warn him of any incorrect step length.

blocks.title: Other tests and features
blocks.html:
The tests that can be performed on Walker View 3.0 SCX are numerous.

Among these you will find:

• The Walk Test: 6 minutes of accurate support analysis;

• Balke’s incremental test, which allows to evaluate aerobic consumption;

• The Cooper Test, which guarantees the evaluation of the maximum running speed and the setting of a personalized running training.

The training modules also allow you to set a course for the user with virtual settings that combine the evasive and playful aspect with the functionality of Walker View 3.0 SCX.

blocks.title: Gait Trainer
blocks.html:
The Gait Trainer module allows the operator to reconstruct a mapping of the patient’s or athlete’s pace through a bio-feedback correction of the gait.

The correction takes place thanks to the presence of regulatory bands in the graphics reproduced on the screen for the user who carries out the test, together with the acoustic signals that warn him of any incorrect step length.

Stance control

The TecnoBody treadmill is equipped with a sensitive load cell belt. This technology allows the assessment of stance during ambulation and, thanks to the powerful software interface, corrects dynamic parameters in real time. Once the test is finished, the system automatically prints the Gait Analysis report..


3D camera

The 3D camcorder placed in front of the Walker View system is the heart of the entire system. Thanks to this sophisticated sensor, the dream of many therapists and trainers could come true: to turn the typical mirror into a digital mirror able to accurately and reliably capture any single angular movement of the runner. This technological magic is done by the Walker View 3D camcorder thanks to two optics, a classic one for high definition (HD) 2D shootings, and an innovative infrared one. By shooting a beam on the subject’s mass, the infrared optics can recreate it almost magically in real time 3D mode.

blocks.title: A Motion Capture Lab
blocks.html: As usual, real innovations always originate from very simple and, at times, paradoxical ideas. The idea behind the project of the TecnoBody R&D team was to place a “digital” mirror in front of an exceptionally sensored treadmill. This solution allowed the integration of three worlds in a single device: the Motion Analysis, the Virtual Reality and the natural and instinctive learning process through the mirror.

Our system had to meet these requirements and be a real evolution of the typical Motion Analysis Laboratory:

– be a simple and practical laboratory for running and gait analysis, designed for trainers, practitioners, and physiotherapists …not for engineers.

– A system for the running and gait analysis that did not require applying annoying markers on the subject’s body, an extremely long and complex process that basically depended on the operator’s skills.

– A cutting-edge treadmill designed to integrate in a single system the processing power of a typical Motion Analysis laboratory with the immediate response benefits provided by the mirror, with the purpose to help our runners correct themselves in real time (while they are running) and not in the post-processing phase.

blocks.title: TecnoBody Key
blocks.html: Each client is unique and each client has their own program, so each client has a TecnoBody Key. Upon insertion into any TecnoBody device, the system recognizes the client and automatically programs the guided training. TecnoBody Key contains not only your client’s training programs, but also and above all, their assessment statistics: force, balance, stability, flexibility, etc. TecnoBody Key is a powerful and flexible system for your patient to follow him/her professionally in all its rehabilitation phases.

blocks.title: The Science Behind Hyperbaric Therapy
blocks.html:
Hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) is the medical use of oxygen in a pressurized environment, at a level higher than 1 atmosphere absolute (ATA).

Increased pressure allows for oxygen to dissolve and saturate the blood plasma (independent of hemoglobin/red blood cells),

which yields a broad variety of positive physiological, biochemical and cellular effects.

This noninvasive therapy is the most trusted way to increase oxygen levels to all organs of the body.

The typical treatment lasts for 60-90 minutes, during which the patient lies down and breathes normally.


HBOT has been demonstrated in several clinical studies to enhance the body’s innate ability to repair and regenerate.

It is used as an adjunct therapy to complement and enhance the healing process in both chronic and acute conditions.

blocks.title: History of Hyperbaric Therapy
blocks.html: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) is a medical treatment that can be traced back to the 1600’s. In 1662, the first renowned chamber was built and operated by a British clergyman named Henshaw. He erected a structure titled, the Domicilium, that was used to treat a variety of conditions. In 1878, Paul Bert, a French physiologist, discovered the link between decompression sickness and nitrogen bubbles. Bert later identified that the pain could be ameliorated with recompression. The concept of treating patients under pressurized conditions was continued by the French surgeon Fontaine, who later built a pressurized mobile operating room in 1879. Fontaine found that inhaled nitrous oxide had a greater potency under pressure, in addition to his patients having improved oxygenation.

blocks.title: Training with flywheel technology
blocks.html:
Training with centrifugal force in the form of kinetic energy is an innovative development in the field of sports and physiotherapy. Instead of traditional weights, you train with flywheels that work independently of gravity. Every movement occurs in two phases: concentric phase and eccentric phase


Phase 1 - Concentric Movement

By investing muscle energy to pull the handle and accelerate the flywheels, they store kinetic energy.Once the strap is fully unwound, the drawstring reaches its maximum length, creating a "point of return" where the drawstring reverses direction and begins to coil, like an inverted yo-yo.Depending on body tension and training style, the amplitude and speed of the "point of return" can be used as a longer or shorter "relaxation" of the muscles.


Phase 2 - Eccentric movement

As the band begins to wind up, it is slowed down by muscle force. The eccentric phase begins instinctively.The person who trains cannot remain passive. It is pulled by the stored kinetic energy with almost the same energy that it put into turning the flywheels and has to brake them. This reaction is instinctive. This phase lasts until the tension band has reached its shortest length and the flywheels are braked at zero speed.A new cycle is initiated by the action of new concentric traction.

  • Optional lens accessories for sun and dust protection, eyesight correction, and reflective markers for motion capture compatibility.
  • Reliable eye tracking across the population regardless of eye color or shape.
  • Slippage compensation and persistent calibration for consistently strong data.
  • Patented 3D eye model and two cameras per eye ensures accurate gaze data.
  • Accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer differentiate head and eye movements.

Visualization and analysis 

View and analyze the data in our easy-to-use software :

  • Controller app that runs on Android, Windows, and macOS in English, Chinese, and Japanese.
  • Observe behavior in real-time with gaze visualizations.
  • Automatic video documentation of user sessions and interviews.
  • Mark events during observation to save time during interview and analysis.
  • Export video in full or in snippets.

blocks.title: The power of the mirror
blocks.html:
In all the gyms of the Health Rehab and Sport World there is a mirror, there has always been.

The mirror has the power of immediacy and a reflected image is worth a thousand words in correcting our posture, to control our motor gesture or simply … to look at us!

In the digital era TecnoBody has redesigned this simple universal element and made it even more powerful, indeed… very powerful!

One day, by now, all the mirrors in the gyms will be digital…

The Digital Wall “D-Wall".

#TBMoveDifferent

blocks.title: D-Wall - Strength
blocks.html:
Power is nothing without control …

Thanks to the Digital Wall, the worldwide pride and patent of the TecnoBody Research Centre, you can enhance your functional strength exercise in an augmented reality environment.

Immersing yourself in a unique experience where posture and strength come together for the total control of the movement in the TecnoBody style, you can control every gesture of strength and exercise of load.Are you ready for change?

blocks.title: D-Wall - Balance
blocks.html:
The rhythm of the body, the melody of the mind and the harmony of the soul create the symphony of life…

Always the control of the balance in sporting practice is the search for perfection of the gesture and inner harmony.

Thanks to the combination of active footrests and accessories for proprioceptivity, D-WALL is the perfect tool for working runners, dancers and skiers with a focus on listening to the motor gesture.

Focus on performance and injury recovery are the protagonists of D-WALL’s BALANCE & POSTURE configuration.

blocks.title: D-WALL H-Sport
blocks.html:
D-WALL is enriched with greater modularity to be even smarter and suitable for the most diverse needs of the personal trainer.

With D-WALL H-Sport you can choose to include the strength platform with stabilometry or to insert in your gym only the wall module with features dedicated only to sports tests and training, depending on your needs.

The most complete and digital gesture analysis and training laboratory on the market today is even more compact and takes up very little space.

Assessment of each motor gesture with maximum control, objective data in real time and detailed reports for the operator. Performance analysis has never been so accurate!

The digital mirror revolution is even smarter!

blocks.title: D-Wall - Accesories
blocks.html:
D-WALL is a versatile, modular and manageable system according to the needs of every trainer and athlete.

Not only the digital mirror allows you to perform workouts with hundreds of different exercises, but above all it is a concentrate of training possibilities in a small space and with different configurations that can be made to measure.

Fitness, balance, posture, weight lifting and rehabilitation can be managed in a single or integrated way thanks to the available accessory kits.

Choose the kit that best suits your needs and those of your athletes and patients!

blocks.title: D-Wall - Functional
blocks.html:
Train like an athlete and win like a champion

In recent years the configuration of many gyms has changed.

Not just exercise equipment to perform exercises in a sitting position, but spaces free of cumbersome tools and focus on a training aimed at listening to their strengths and weaknesses.

The movements reflect the gestures of everyday life, natural movements realized thanks to the synergistic contraction of several muscle groups.

Coordination, speed, responsiveness and agility are just some of the specificities to be put into play for a functional workout, all characteristics of the athlete that with D-WALL is easy to find in real time with an accurate analysis aimed at continuous improvement of performance.

blocks.title: Polar Software Package Real-time cardio monitoring, always available.
blocks.html:
Thanks to the possibility of association with the Polar Software Package, you have the opportunity to monitor the cardio parameters of your athlete or patient at any time.


The association with the system of the brachial, thoracic, wrist, smartwatch or any heart rate detection device based on BLE technology, guarantees the safety of training and the setting of objectives related to specific training libraries.


Subject-specific targets can be set by the operator to customize workouts and maximize the subject's performance. While using the system, you can continuously refer to the parking percentages and specific areas.


Leading your athlete to the best performance during high intensity workouts, such as HIIT and Tabata, has never been easier!

title: BLINK.PRO
subtitle: Psychomotor skills training
about_html: Fitness training device that allows your psychomotor skills to reach their peak performance. This means, improving physical movements associated with conscious cognitive processing. BLINK.PRO helps you with three things: become faster than others, become faster than yourself by improving your reflexes and maintains your psychomotor abilities on a top level while competing.

blocks.html: How does it work?

Step 1

Just plug it in


BLINK.PRO is a Plug & Play device, so no configuration is required.

It supports wireless connection with remote devices such your smartphone or tablet,

but they are not required. BLINK.PRO has a built-in 7-inch touchscreen

so you can use it without any additional devices.

Just press the button to start your training session.

Step 2

Improve your skills


You don’t need anyone around for training sessions.

The BLINK.PRO machine uses AI, which allows you to improve your speed,

even when training in single player mode.

The AI included in the machine focuses on enhancing your reaction times.

The faster you are, the more demanding a training routine becomes.

Step 3

Analyze the data


Check how quickly your motor skills react to sensory information.

Ensure your movements are quick and coordinated.

Compare results and check your progress.

All of these you can do by analyzing the data gathered by the device.

Step 4

Compete with others


BLINK.PRO supports multiplayer competition mode,

allowing you to train with your sparring partner.

By adding BLINK.PRO training to your workout routine,you improve your reflexes,

maintain your psychomotor abilities at a top level while competing,

all in order to hone your world class athlete motor skills
